title: G6 sensor - "G5 Sensor Requesting Restart" - now no signal
body:
Hi,
My daughter's been using her current G6 sensor for 11 days using XDrip and a Sony Smartwatch 3 - with forced collection on the watch. The sensor is set to restart automatically.

This evening, her watch displayed the message 'G5 sensor requesting restart', and since then we've had no readings. I've updated to the latest nightly, disabled collection from the watch, but still no joy.

The log seems to be showing issues connecting.

This is the first time we've used a sensor beyond 10 days (we've only been on the G6 a month). Is this issue relating to the restart of the sensor, or is it something else?

Thanks for any help.

comments.body:
Now showing as 'sensor stopped'. Message on watch says "Unusual session start failure, is transmitter crashed? Try Hard Reset?"

Continued to do a hard reset - status on phone has now said 'Resetting - please wait" for 10 minutes.
Having fired up the official dexcom app on an iphone and installed a new sensor, it seems the transmitter has failed - only a month old.
@meatychunks99 Do you still have issues with xDrip?  If not, would you please close this issue?
